Ready to go deeper? Choose a topic, then work through its hands-on pads. Use the filters to find topics relevant to your research.

<div class="deep-water-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter Deep End topics">
  <div>

<p id="deep-empty" hidden>No topics match those filters. Try changing or clearing a filter.</p>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const filters = {
    focus: document.getElementById("deep-focus"),
    language: document.getElementById("deep-language")
  };
  const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll(".deep-water-card")];
  const count = document.getElementById("deep-count");
  const empty = document.getElementById("deep-empty");

  function updateCards() {
    let shown = 0;
    for (const card of cards) {
      const matches = Object.entries(filters).every(([key, select]) =>
        !select.value || card.dataset[key].split(" ").includes(select.value)
      );
      card.hidden = !matches;
      if (matches) shown++;
    }
    count.textContent = `${shown} ${shown === 1 ? "topic" : "topics"} shown`;
    empty.hidden = shown !== 0;
  }

  Object.values(filters).forEach(select => select.addEventListener("change", updateCards));
  document.getElementById("deep-clear").addEventListener("click", () => {
    Object.values(filters).forEach(select => { select.value = ""; });
    updateCards();
    filters.focus.focus();
  });
  updateCards();
});
</script>
